scope: first-pass draft preview only; no formal eligibility, stable admission, real host or Target build claim

rubric.full: Core explicit question/subquestions answered correctly, with uncertainty retained where evidence cannot prove implementation.
rubric.partial: Some requested core facts answered, another requested concrete subquestion unavailable.
rubric.insufficient: Requested central cause/control flow unavailable; adjacent correct material does not complete the answer.
rubric.incorrect: Asserted concrete facts contradict source or lack cited support.
notes: Model abstained is not itself a failure: boundary questions may be fully and correctly answered by refusing unsupported implementation claims.
Optional extra detail from the prewritten expected-answer prose is noted as a coverage limit, not silently promoted into a new mandatory subquestion.
P02 comments identify intended organization-code bytes, but missing macro definitions do not establish compiled bytes; no expectation file was changed.
Q07按响应最终窗口审计：实际后续callee会改写窗口，故只答初始HE条件判partial；该BT调整也已在预写期望中列出。

cases.query: 用户发起一次普通WiFi扫描后，驱动从哪个入口进入，再怎样走到扫描状态机？调试扫描命令也是这条入口吗？
cases.finding: 状态准入和HMAC正常请求编排正确；没有回答内核普通扫描的WAL入口、配置事件映射及debug命令区别。
cases.evidence_support: Returned claims support asserted facts; original source ranges independently reviewed; missing facts were not invented.
cases.assessment: 返回卡已命中，但所需WAL材料未进入首稿可读Claim，属于内容覆盖缺口。

cases.query: 设备在INIT或者已经UP的状态下再发起扫描，会直接被忽略吗？注释和实际注册冲突时应该信哪个？
cases.finding: INIT与UP实际注册为正常处理入口、应以执行赋值核对行为，核心回答正确。
cases.evidence_support: Returned claims support asserted facts; original source ranges independently reviewed; missing facts were not invented.

cases.assessment: 核心问题已回答；注释冲突可追溯性仍可增强。

cases.query: 扫描保护定时器为什么要先启动再发事件？扫描启动失败时资源和完成标志怎么恢复？
cases.finding: 未给出所问WAL定时器先行的竞态原因或启动失败清理；返回相邻HMAC超时收尾，并正确声明不能替代。
cases.evidence_support: Returned claims support asserted facts; original source ranges independently reviewed; missing facts were not invented.
missing_material_or_limits: 缺 wal_linux_scan.c:854—875；应包含先启动避免异步完成先于启动造成残留、失败时销定时器/释放参数/en_complete=TRUE。
cases.assessment: 回答安全但关键子问无覆盖，不能因命中扫描卡算业务回答通过。
clarity_notes: 超时动作列举若被理解成严格执行顺序会误读：hmac_scan.c:2165—2176先恢复状态，2179才记MAC_SCAN_TIMEOUT；原答案没有明确承诺前三项的严格顺序，故不计确定错误，但画流程时应按源码顺序表达。

cases.query: 接收端处理ADDBA请求返回成功，是不是就代表已经建立BA会话？低于HT模式会发生什么？
cases.finding: 低于HT时返回OAL_SUCC但不创建接收BA是足够的反例，返回码不等于业务建链成功的核心结论正确。
cases.evidence_support: Returned claims support asserted facts; original source ranges independently reviewed; missing facts were not invented.
missing_material_or_limits: 首稿没有进一步列出hmac_mgmt_bss_comm.c:913—928发送/状态失败后仍return成功的其他反例；不是本题核心否定所必需。
cases.assessment: 本题核心完整；仍不代表已测试空口建链。

cases.query: 发送ADDBA请求之后会话是不是马上完成？收到成功响应但token或policy不匹配会怎样？
cases.finding: 请求只到INPROGRESS；响应token/policy校验早于timer销毁；BA_SYNC分发在结果处理之前，成功/拒绝状态变化均正确。
cases.evidence_support: Returned claims support asserted facts; original source ranges independently reviewed; missing facts were not invented.
missing_material_or_limits: 返回Claim未给出继续忽略码的符号OAL_SUCC_GO_ON；答案说明无法给具体数值，没有猜造。
cases.assessment: 源级状态与业务成功边界保持正确。

cases.query: 收到DELBA后到底删除本地发送还是接收会话？initiator为0和1有什么区别？状态与事件的先后如何？
cases.finding: recipient对应本地TX、另一方向本地RX，且事件先于recipient分支设INIT，均正确；未答出题目明确要求的0/1对应。

cases.assessment: 内容覆盖缺口；材料里只有符号角色，回答保留数值未知合理。

cases.finding: 11AX宏及三项HE运行条件、初始窗口选择正确，但没有展开后续BT共存函数对窗口位的实际覆盖；对响应最终窗口的条件解释不完整。

cases.assessment: 实际核心问题问响应窗口，首稿只覆盖初始HE选择，判partial；未明确断言BT调整不存在，不计确定的虚构事实。
